name: Get the party started
author: kidchameleon
description: Sometimes when you go into a nightclub everyone can be nervous about dancing. You are b-girl blaze. A well-respected breakdancer. Walk into people to inspire them. You can dance by holding z,x or c. Use arrow keys to move and the mouse to toggle the ui. Music:Alexandr Zhelanov, art CRESCENT DIAL GAMES, Animations: Mixamo. A big thank you to the creative core team. This is my final project. I have learned more skills that are not all included in this game, but I will be using URP in my next game.
